name: deer-unknown
label: Highbeam Deer — benchmark, unknown pattern
cue: It freezes. Like a deer in headlights. Light gathers behind its eyes. It is not frozen. It is aiming. It's about to break loose!

name: deer-known
label: Highbeam Deer — benchmark, pattern learned
cue: It freezes. Like a deer in headlights. Light gathers behind its eyes. It is not frozen. It is aiming. It's about to break loose! You know this one: Ocular Discharge fires a sweeping beam that tracks you while it burns — outrun it sideways, block it with walls, or close in and break its aim. The freeze is the tell. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare.

name: middlemanager-unknown
label: Middle Manager (wave-2C) — unknown
cue: "let's take this OFFLINE." It lowers its horns. The meeting line is SET — attendance is mandatory. It is staring down a line on the ground. You should not be on that line.

name: middlemanager-known
label: Middle Manager (wave-2C) — known
cue: "let's take this OFFLINE." It lowers its horns. The meeting line is SET — attendance is mandatory. It charges exactly the announced line, width 2 — sidestep FARTHER than feels necessary. You know this one: Circle Back circles wide to cut off escape, then charges the announced line — wide (width 2), exactly where it said. The telegraph is the circling; read the line, sidestep far.

name: inspiration-unknown
label: Inspiration (wave-2C) — unknown
cue: ⚠ It sits perfectly still, glowing brighter and brighter. A beautiful idea, taking shape. You can feel the brilliance building. That's when you realize: ideas this bright are never safe to stand next to.

name: inspiration-known
label: Inspiration (wave-2C) — known
cue: ⚠ It's brightening. Two beats from glow to boom — BACK OFF. Radius 2. You know this one: Eureka hits everything close around it. It glows brighter before detonation. When it flares, RUN.

name: nostalgia-unknown
label: Nostalgia (wave-2C) — unknown
cue: It unfolds a screen of light between the trees. And there — impossibly — is home. Your street. Your kitchen. Someone you miss, laughing. You take a step closer without deciding to. The light has edges. The edges are sharp.

name: nostalgia-known
label: Nostalgia (wave-2C) — known
cue: It's showing you home to hold you still. The beam runs along your line of gaze — MOVE. Keep moving and the picture can't hold. You know this one: Home Movies fires in a straight line from itself. The picture holds you still. Keep moving and it can't lock on.

name: glasswing-unknown
label: Glasswing Darter — dive shadow, unknown
cue: A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky.

name: glasswing-known
label: Glasswing Darter — dive shadow, known
cue: A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky. You know this one: Skyfall Dive picks one target and commits — the windup tells you how to beat it. Watch the shadow, not the bug. Move when it grows.

name: sunbasker-unknown
label: Sunbasker — heat halo, unknown
cue: Its scales go molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. Something is about to happen.

name: sunbasker-known
label: Sunbasker — heat halo, known
cue: Fully gold — Sun-Charged Bite incoming. It tracks: hit it NOW and the charge dies before it lands. You know this one: Sun-Charged Bite picks one target and commits — the windup tells you how to beat it. Don't let it bask. Hit it every turn or drag it to shade.

name: bulldozer
label: Bulldozer (wave-1 charge) — comparison
cue: Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything. It's about to break loose!

name: lockpick
label: Lockpick (wave-1 thief) — opening tell, no declare

name: flashbulb
label: Flashbulb Moth (wave-1 burst) — comparison
cue: It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp. It's about to break loose!
